physical_observation: Small detached mark at fraction-bar height beyond its endpoint, above the final denominator factorial; separate larger product period before a_m. No second complete punctuation glyph is established; physical cause unassigned.

coefficient_comparison.map: ch=eta∘Log; eta restricts in degree r>=1 to multiplication by c_r=(-1)^(r-1)/(r-1)!.
coefficient_comparison.input_leading_terms: For phi=1+a_m+higher and psi=1+b_n+higher, ch(phi)=c_m a_m+higher and ch(psi)=c_n b_n+higher.
coefficient_comparison.multiplication: The proved multiplicativity gives ch(phi*psi)=ch(phi)ch(psi). The first possible nonconstant component has degree m+n.
coefficient_comparison.exact_scalar: Writing d_(m+n) for that component of phi*psi, c_(m+n)d_(m+n)=c_m c_n a_m b_n. Thus d_(m+n)=-(m+n-1)!/((m-1)!(n-1)!) a_m b_n.
coefficient_comparison.integral_descent: This comparison is performed first in the rational extension of the universal polynomial ring with independent homogeneous input coefficients. Its integral polynomial ring injects into that extension. The displayed integer scalar equals-(m+n-1)binom(m+n-2,m-1), so equality descends there and then along the evaluation homomorphism sending the independent input coefficients to the given a_i,b_j. This preserves the single multiplication in the source formula.

filtration_identification: The printed shorthand0×1+A-hat^(>=n) is the image of u↦(0,1+u), u in product_(i>=n)A^i, in K×I(A). The symbols phi and psi in the next lines use the inverse second-coordinate projection on this image.
inverse_map: Under the explicitly printed Q-algebra scope, ch(a,phi)=a+eta(Log phi) has inverse a+psi1↦(a,exp(eta^(-1)psi1)). On degree r, eta^(-1) multiplies by(-1)^(r-1)(r-1)!, and completed Log/exp compose to the identity. Both compositions retain the same scalar a.
disposition: No new punctuation token or replacement theorem. Preserve the observed mark in the evidence and the existing single-product formula in both layers.
